newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint steady vs NBH basket,firms vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint steady vs NBH basket,firms vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint opened firmer against the dollar and steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket on Monday, but it may weaken versus the basket if the bearish trend on Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) continues, dealers said.
"I do not see a substantial drop unless foreigners begin to sell Hungarian stocks," Attila Behan of ING Bank said.

The BUX index of the BSE fell more than six percent last week as some of the first half earnings reports caused disappointment, while the dollar's weakening against the forint and falls on Wall Street also contributed to the falls.

The fall of Hungarian shares followed several months in which the BSE posted strong gains and traders said that the shares' weakening was likely to continue if the Dow would ease further and the dollar would fall against the forint.
Wall Street fell more than three percent on Friday.

The forint opened right at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), at 195.75/80, and stood at 195.71/77 at 0730 GMT, well down from Friday's closing 197.85/90 on the mark's gains versus the dollar since Friday.
The 10 basis point reduction in the monthly crawling peg devaluation on Friday left the interbank currency exchange market unaffected, dealers said.
"The cut had been announced months ago," Behan said. "And such a little cut does not have a large impact."
